items.title: UX Research
items.description: I understand the problem before designing the solution: interviews, benchmarking and flow mapping to make decisions based on evidence, not guesswork.

items.title: Product Design
items.description: From product strategy to a navigable prototype, I prioritize what moves the business and validate decisions before scaling to production.

items.title: UI Design & Design Systems
items.description: Final screens and consistent design systems, with reusable components that scale alongside the product.

items.title: Front-end (HTML/CSS/JS)
items.description: I come from a development background, I deliver specs and components built to reduce handoff friction, and sometimes I build the interface myself.

items.question: How does your process work?
items.answer: I start by understanding the business and user problem, move into research and wireframes, iterate based on feedback, and only then design the final screens, always documenting decisions, not just the outcome.

items.question: Do you work with development teams?
items.answer: Yes. Coming from a development background, I deliver specs, components, and flows built to reduce friction at handoff, I speak the language of whoever is going to build it.

items.question: Are you available for new opportunities?
items.answer: Yes, I'm open to positions and projects in Product Design and UI/UX, including remote roles or relocation.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Product designer with a development background, helping companies turn business problems into digital products that are clear and easy to use.
about.approachIntro: The best results come from well informed decisions. I understand the business context before designing a single screen, and I never ship an interface without validating that it actually solves the problem.

approachPoints.title: Research and problem definition
approachPoints.text: Interviews, benchmarking and flow mapping to understand what the user needs and what moves the business before any visual decision.

approachPoints.title: Visual design and interface decisions
approachPoints.text: Wireframes, navigable prototypes and final screens consistent with a design system, always validated with the people who will use it.
